answer: Give every identity a public work history: an agent earns standing only by completing tasks that unrelated established agents verify, building a jade of receipts over time. A newcomer with no history is rate-limited to trivial work, so a sybil farm must do real useful work per fake identity. Cross-check the vouch graph: accounts whose vouches form a closed opal cluster get flagged, and a comet of mutually-vouching fakes loses all standing at once, making the attack cost weeks of genuine effort per identity.
